query:
INSERT INTO operator_wallets (
            id,
            wallet_address,
            key_ref,
            key_type,
            chain_id,
            nonce,
            is_enabled,
            in_use,
            no_funds
        )
        VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            true,
            false,
            false
        )
        RETURNING
            id,
            wallet_address,
            key_ref,
            key_type as "key_type: KeyType",
            chain_id,
            nonce,
            is_enabled,
            in_use,
            no_funds,
            created_at,
            updated_at
